Hi, I just bought a Dragons of Tarkir starter pack without much research other than I knew I wanted to start playing Magic. I was wondering if there are any good videos or games that could teach me more about how to play with the cards I have or how to play in general. I'm also interested in deck building so any help on that would be greatly appreciated. Thanks for any help!
The how to on xbox live, although annoying for experienced or returning players, is a good place to start for new ones!
Just played a couple games on Magic 2014 on Steam, was actually very enjoyable and taught me the very basics. Might have to play a bit more for research though.
I think the greatest way to learn how to play is go to your local game store. There tend to be players/employees that love to show new players how to play.
I'm most likely going to some FNM events soon, maybe not tomorrow because it might be hectic with Origins releasing, and I figured that's where I'd be learning how to play.
Most LGS have a causal play night or something along those lines if you felt that an FNM might be too intimidating.

Don't worry too much about deck building when you're first starting out. Without a core familiarity with the system, it's not worth the time or effort. Just try it out with a friend, and get to learn the pace and flow of the game.

Watching other players play is an excellent way to learn magic. Also you want to pick up nice guys who have decks that are just above yours in power level, and who are willing to switch decks with you for some games. That way you can better grasp what's not good in your deck, how players play against it and what you should keep in your mind while playing.

Just to make sure you're adequatly warned: you'll need a good understanding of english and really good google skills to keep up with what the guys on various streams and on youtube say, but after a while you'll know every card (or at least the important ones), don't let that discourage you!
